en_how: A sand-coloured plaster wall is built from fractal noise and divided into horizontal registers; figures with profile heads, frontal eyes and shoulders (sized by rank) are flat-filled in earth red, malachite green and lapis blue with fine black outlines, then flaked and cracked by a weathering layer; a column of hieroglyphs is rewritten stroke by stroke, and the wall slides down like a stone slab to reveal the next register.
